items.name: Kubus Bali Reborn 2017

venue.name: STMIK Primakara
venue.address: Jl. Tukad Badung No.135, Renon, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80226
venue.details: The venue is on the hall of this college (aula kampus) on the 4th floor.

items.information: The registration fee is IDR 75.000 for early bird and IDR 100.000 for on the spot payment. The early bird payment will be closed at D-2 weeks (17 June). All competitors will get a free sticker from us. Please check the website or contact the organizers for further information.

items.name: No Stress Solving 2017
items.information: The registration fee is $10. There is a 60 person competitor limit. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Improper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the competitors tab within 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, and many unofficial events on the events tab.

items.name: Quanzhou Open 2017
items.information: We have a limit of 125 competitors. Please check the competition website for more information like events and schedule.
